reopen_condition: A compatible public selection/injection campaign or equivalent public selection-function artifact becomes available under a separately frozen release contract.
The primary public remnant/ringdown schema and field semantics become unambiguous under a new preregistered audit.
An external release exposes a compatible common parameter/schema frame sufficient for a preregistered replication test.
A common release/event/PE lineage frame is frozen and an explicit end-to-end substitution/propagation experiment is preregistered.
Compatible common-event strain/DQ/calibration, detection/catalog and PE artifacts are frozen for controlled numerical propagation.
Population and cosmology products share an exact release/event-frame contract and a dedicated propagation analysis is preregistered.
A compatible end-to-end release frame permits controlled intervention or substitution without confounding multiple analysis dimensions.
A new preregistration freezes the grid+density conversion before primary computation; historical post-hoc values remain post-hoc.
Treat each new release as a new frozen audit rather than silently transporting current contracts.
